text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Carrying the hopes of Japan as she enters 
the gate! And now, the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is underway!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! The season for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is here! El-El will be sending 
her cheers all the way from Japan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Howeveeer! Out on the track, her 
experience and ability are unquestionable! 
This is going to be one great 
international match, YES!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fueled by their burning desire to 
reach the pinnacle, her team seems to be 
taking on the world.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And... El. In your heart, you still hold 
onto that dream of taking on the world, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I heard that you, who left racing to 
search for a successor, were aiming for 
the world yourself once again... ...I was 
truly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Whoops, as of now she's third from the 
back! Is that a bit too far behind? That's 
a tough position to be in!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Grass! I'll go grab some drinks!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, world glory remains out of reach 
for both El and that girl.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Compared to when I ran, the eyes on 
Japanese Umamusume are even sharper now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That means they recognize us as rivals. 
Proof that the level of Japanese Umamusume 
has risen. I'm happy about that, but at 
the same time—

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... No way... I guess winning the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe really is impossible, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Our chances of winning have become 
much easier to crush."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ..."I knew it". ..."Impossible".

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Above El-El and the others, huge, thick 
clouds are spreading. Inside them... El 
is...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You didn't go on an expedition this year, 
did you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Sirius-senpai.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're very caring, aren't you? Going out 
of your way to call out to an Umamusume 
who was trying to be alone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. What's with that tone? Do you want 
me to dote on you too?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I decline, desu.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"What unbelievable power! A new chapter in 
the history of the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe has been written right here!!"

"That night, countless programs covered 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Between TV, 
UmaTube, and Umasta Live... there was an 
endless stream of things to watch."
(Dong, dong)

"Tomorrow, I have plans to meet Nakayama 
Festa's former teacher, as promised."

We're heading to the racing class run by 
her father. Considering the meeting time, 
it's about time I went to bed.

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Next, we'll be going live to the 
Umamusume and Trainer who took on the 
challenge!"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
"In 2 hours! I'll be doing a direct 
interview with someone who knows the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe winner very well! No 
archive will be available due to the other 
party's request!"

choice_data_list:
We should definitely watch this 
livestream...
I really need to watch this livestream...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...The dark circles under your eyes are 
awful. Just how long has it been since you 
slept?
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine! No need to worry!

text_block_list.text:
Right now, what was needed wasn't sleep, 
but information.

"Information on the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, info on Nakayama Festa... 
whatever it takes to secure victory—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Trainer. Would it be 
alright if we change our plans after all?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry. Truth is, I've just always 
wanted to visit Festa's school at least 
once.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to arrange another time to 
speak to my father. So won't you let me 
off today with just sharing my memories 
instead?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Huh~ I didn't know the Academy gave every 
Trainer such a fancy room!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh? This is about yesterday's Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe... And past articles on 
other overseas races, too...
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry! It's such a mess in here...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, cleaning up now won't do you any 
good. Sensei has the sharpest eyes around, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Because I'm so sharp-eyed, 
it's easy for me to spot all sorts of 
things. Like the exact moment Festa tries 
to sneak out of school.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"In the past, she used to be more passive, 
spending her days just spacing out, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...What? Got a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I didn't know a single fun 
thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In a place without life or death. Just 
breathing aimlessly. Just... existing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My heart wasn't in it, nothing was 
moving— it was just a bunch of boring, 
meaningless days.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
To break that boredom, you picked up 
dangerous games, didn't you? ...How 
nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, would it be alright 
if I used the tea leaves on that shelf?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Because reminiscing about the past calls 
for a warm drink.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
At my elementary school, teachers had a 
tradition of sharing notes at the end of 
the year—telling the next homeroom teacher 
what kind of kid they'd be looking after.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That was when I heard about Festa. ...And 
went to see her time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"If you love competing so much, why don't 
you aim to go pro?"

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's obviously boring. Going out 
of your way just to get tied down by 
rules."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, what a silly child. Even our play had 
rules, didn't it? 'Whoever reaches the 
goal first wins.'"

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: "...Quit splitting hairs."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"It's not making excuses. Rules exist so 
we can enjoy the competition. You just 
don't understand that yet."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"—If you're looking for a real thrill, 
this place isn't gonna cut it."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...What I said back then was a gamble for 
me."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And so, I took Festa to the racing academy 
that my father ran.

text_block_list.name: Racing Class Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ‘Yaaaaaaaaah!’

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
“Nakayama Festa in 4th! Your weight 
shifting was way too sloppy!”

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: "Haa... haa..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"See? Completely different, right? Every 
single girl in this classroom is betting 
her life on running."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "How was this world, then?"

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
""............ ...My heart is beating so 
loud.""

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text: "......What it means to be alive."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I became even more meddlesome after that. 
The following week, I even took them to 
Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
"...Incredible. So this is the Twinkle 
Series."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the stage for Japan's ultimate 
competition—the very one those kids back 
in that classroom are aiming for. ...Do 
you like it?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. You can definitely reach it. After 
all, you're overflowing with a talent for 
competition."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
After that, it all happened in a flash. 
Festa quickly began to stand out in my 
father's racing class.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...That's just how captivating it was. 
Racing, that is."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
My! You've become much more honest about 
expressing yourself than before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Cut that out, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I think everything started from 
that moment.”

—At that moment, I felt like the outline 
of the Umamusume known as Nakayama Festa 
became distinct.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll see you off, Teacher.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No, this is plenty far enough. Thank you 
as well, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
The pleasure was all mine, thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: No. Please get plenty of rest after this.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
If your desk was that buried in 
research... you must have sacrificed a 
great deal of sleep. Please, take care of 
yourself.
choice_data_list: ...! I'm sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but I truly admire your passion. Now 
then—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Doc.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...? What is it, Festa?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...The Twinkle Series is so hot, it feels 
like it could burn you."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Just running makes my heartbeat, my 
pulse, my whole body scream out—'I'm 
alive!'"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then have your Trainer make even 
better use of it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Because I truly believe 'hope keeps people 
going.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hope?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To me, the two of you look more 
vibrant than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships lie ahead, your 
eyes will never lose their light. I'm sure 
that's because the two of you hold onto 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, some people say winning the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is impossible, 
but I believe in you two."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Live your life to the fullest, Festa. With 
your Trainer. In your world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I'll show Sensei too. The future 
we lived for.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Someday, the me who conquers the world 
will also—
